message:
The other day, we were all set for a fun family outing when my partner suddenly remembered we had to grab our go-bags from the closet. It was one of those moments where you think, "Do we really need them?" But we decided to take a minute to pack them up just in case. 

Fast forward to a few hours later, and we found ourselves in the middle of a surprise rainstorm. 🌧️ Thanks to our little bags, we stayed dry and comfortable with extra ponchos and snacks. It felt like such a small win, but it turned a potentially soggy day into a memorable adventure. 

Have you had a small preparedness win that made a big difference? We’d love to hear your stories!
